headroom_gate.interpretation: A qualifying basis/family must show two regime-specific winners different from each other and the pooled fixed choice; each winner must meet calibration stability and independent development utility thresholds. The same regime pair must qualify at two or more distances. This is a feasibility gate, not confirmatory significance testing.

selection_rules.pooled_fixed: minimum equal-weight mean calibration logical-error rate over the three regimes; ties go to the lowest candidate index
selection_rules.regime_specialist: minimum calibration logical-error rate in each regime; ties go to the lowest candidate index
selection_rules.detector_marginal_fit: Jeffreys-smoothed per-detector Bernoulli profiles; sum composite Bernoulli log score across detectors; ties go to the lowest candidate index
